title: Ordinary evaluation and the postcomposition differential
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $U$ an open, and let $P,F$ be arbitrary cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_U$-modules. Let $D=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,\mathcal O_U[0])$ and let $C_{p,q,n,r}$ be the projected ordinary evaluation component of [lem-pc-bounded-ordinary-evaluation-assembly]. For integers $p,q,n,m,r$ with $p+q=n$ and $n+1=m$, $C_{p,q,n,r}$ followed by postcomposition with $d_F^{r+n,r+m}$ equals $(d_F^{p,p+1}\otimes 1)C_{p+1,q,m,r}$.

source.place: Tag 08DQ, ordinary complex comparison; Section 20.41, Hom-complex differential

proof.text:
If r+q is nonzero, both evaluation components vanish. Otherwise p=r+n
and p+1=r+m. Expand the component definition, and move d_F across the
right unitor, the associator and the braidings by naturality. Naturality of
the tensor-Hom equivalence in its output identifies postcomposition by d_F
with the whiskered differential on F. Degree transports agree by proof
irrelevance. This uses no boundedness and also holds for zero modules.

theorem ordinaryEvaluation_post_differential (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (P F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ)
    (n m p q r : ℤ) (hnm : n + 1 = m) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    localEvaluationComponent X U P F p q n r hpq ≫
        SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := X.sheaf.over U) (𝟙 (P.X r)) (F.d (r + n) (r + m)) =
      (F.d p (p + 1) ▷ (localEvaluationDual X U P).X q) ≫
        localEvaluationComponent X U P F (p + 1) q m r (by omega)
